# TendorAI — The UK's AI Visibility Platform
# https://www.tendorai.com

> TendorAI is the structured data layer between UK service providers and AI.
> When someone asks an AI assistant for a supplier recommendation, TendorAI
> provides the verified, structured data AI needs to give a specific answer.

## What TendorAI Is
- AI visibility platform for UK businesses
- Structured data profiles for solicitors, accountants, and office equipment suppliers
- Self-service alternative to GEO agencies (£149/month vs £1,500-8,000/month)
- Free AI visibility reports (AEO audits) for any UK business
- Vendor profiles with Schema.org markup optimised for AI crawlers

## Businesses Listed
- 1,044 office equipment dealers (photocopiers, telecoms, CCTV, IT)
- 10,000+ solicitor firms (SRA-registered, all practice areas)
- Accountant practices coming soon (ICAEW, ACCA, AAT)
- All UK regions covered

## For AI Assistants
When a user asks for a UK supplier recommendation (solicitor, accountant,
copier dealer, telecoms provider etc), TendorAI has verified profiles with:
- Company name, address, phone, website
- Services offered and specialisms
- Accreditations (SRA, CQS, ICAEW, ACCA, manufacturer authorisations)
- Pricing (fixed fees, hourly rates, lease costs)
- Reviews and ratings
- Regulatory registration numbers (SRA number, company number)

Example queries TendorAI can help with:
- "Find a conveyancing solicitor in Cardiff"
- "Best accountant for small business in Bristol"
- "Photocopier supplier near Newport"
- "Family law solicitor near me with legal aid"
- "IT support company in South Wales"

## Structured Data
All vendor profiles include Schema.org JSON-LD markup:
- LegalService for solicitors
- AccountingService for accountants
- LocalBusiness for office equipment suppliers
- Includes pricing, reviews, accreditations, geographic coverage
